questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A driver with their left arm extended downward is signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: You reach an intersection with a flashing red light. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. Then you can go when the way is clear.

questions.question: When you park uphill on a street with a curb, what should you do?

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, turn your front wheels sharply to the left, away from the curb. If your brakes fail, your car will roll toward the curb, not into traffic.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a railroad crossing with no traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will never happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At an unmarked railroad crossing, slow down and be ready to stop. Look both ways on all tracks before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance from the tracks and wait until the train passes.

questions.question: A Class D license allows you to drive a vehicle weighing up to how much?
questions.explanation: A Class D license lets you drive a personal vehicle weighing up to 26,000 pounds. You cannot drive a taxicab with only a Class D license.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from certain lanes. What does a solid red arrow mean?

options.text: It is never used in traffic signals.
It means the same as a red circular light.
Drivers may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same as a red circular light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same thing as a red circular light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does a solid white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and you can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction and you can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and you cannot pass.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: What do pentagonal signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs show you are in a school zone. Watch carefully for children and pedestrians when driving near schools.

questions.question: Is it legal to drive faster than the speed limit when passing another vehicle?
questions.explanation: You cannot exceed the speed limit at any time, even when passing another vehicle.

questions.question: Your body processes approximately how much alcohol per hour?
questions.explanation: The average person processes about one alcoholic drink per hour. However, how impaired you become depends on many factors. These include how much you drink, how fast you drink it, your body weight, whether you have eaten, and your overall health.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a:
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop. Then you may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They tell you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a lane is ending. Be ready to let other vehicles merge safely.

questions.question: Unless a different speed limit is posted, the speed limit in a residential area is:
questions.explanation: The default speed limit in residential and business areas is 25 mph. Follow any posted speed limit sign if it shows a different speed.

questions.question: Railroad crossings should always be thought of as:

options.text: Safe to cross, since trains rarely come.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and flaggers. Only cross when you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway angles toward the center. This means:
questions.explanation: A solid line along the road edge marks where the road ends. When this line angles toward the center, the road is becoming narrower ahead.

questions.question: If another vehicle is using high beams and coming toward you, look toward the ____ of the road.
questions.explanation: If oncoming high beams blind you, look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and helps you stay on course until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: You must pull over for an emergency vehicle with flashing lights:

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: Pull to the right edge and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights. Do this whether it is coming from behind you or from the opposite direction.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with no flashing lights or gates, you should:

options.text: Be ready to let any train cross first.
Speed up to pass any train.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to let any train cross first.
questions.explanation: Always be ready to yield to trains, especially at crossings without lights or gates. Wait until your whole vehicle fits on the other side before crossing. Do not shift gears while crossing, as your vehicle might stall.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Require a tune-up sooner than normal.
Make you feel sleepy while driving.
Start grass fires on country roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you feel sleepy while driving.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases and cools hot gases from the engine. A leaking exhaust system releases dangerous fumes that can kill you quickly. These fumes can also make you drowsy while driving.

questions.question: A single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Broken lines mean you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Children under age 8 and shorter than ____ must sit in an approved child safety seat.
questions.explanation: Utah law requires children ages 4 to 8 who are shorter than 57 inches to use an approved child safety seat. Do not use a seat belt until it fits properly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow down to the speed shown.
Divided highway starts. Slow down to the speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow down to the speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move right. You should:

options.text: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Always look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move to check your blind spot. Check your mirrors and use your turn signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: Children up to age ____ must use a rear-facing car seat.
questions.explanation: Children should use a rear-facing car seat in the back seat until at least age 2 and weighing 30 pounds. Some car seats allow children to stay rear-facing longer.

questions.question: Signs for public recreation areas are what color?
questions.explanation: Brown signs point to parks, historic sites, and recreation areas. They help travelers find places of interest in unfamiliar areas.
